title: Two Hands Corporation Begins External Beta Testing for EntangleX Quantum Simulator - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Two Hands Corporation Begins External Beta Testing for EntangleX Quantum Simulator

Micro-cap technology holding firm Two Hands Corporation (OTC: TWOH)—which is in the process of changing its corporate identity to Quantum X Inc.—has announced that the base user interface for its internally developed quantum circuit simulation software, EntangleX, is now open to selected external partners for third-party beta testing. The milestone follows a phase of internal development led by project lead Ujjwal Roy and CEO Emil Assentato.

Designed as a browser-based, GPU-accelerated simulation environment, EntangleX allows technical teams, researchers, and educators to model, execute, and analyze quantum circuits using classical infrastructure without requiring direct access to physical quantum processors. The platform includes a visual circuit builder, a library of standard quantum algorithm templates, programmatic submission APIs, usage tracking, and multi-user collaborative team workspaces. To accommodate data privacy and institutional security requirements, the company is engineering the platform to support both hosted cloud access and private, customer-controlled on-premises data center deployments.

The external beta phase will evaluate platform usability, circuit-building workflow clarity, results presentation, and simulation stability across independent environments. Two Hands Corporation emphasized that EntangleX is a classical simulation tool rather than physical quantum hardware, with simulation scale and circuit depth bounded by available GPU memory and classical processing capacity. The company expects to introduce further software enhancements later in 2026 based on beta feedback, though no commercial release dates, pricing, or customer contracts have been finalized.
